name: Valid login grants access to protected functionality
preconditions: Given the Stride login screen is displayed
steps: When the user enters username admin and password admin
And submits the login form
expected: Then the app shell is visible and the login screen is hidden

name: Invalid credentials are rejected with appropriate message
preconditions: Given the Stride login screen is displayed
steps: When the user enters invalid credentials
And submits the login form
expected: Then an error alert is shown and the app shell remains hidden

name: Mandatory login fields are validated
preconditions: Given the Stride login screen is displayed
steps: When the user leaves username or password empty
And attempts to submit
expected: Then HTML5 required validation prevents login

name: Password field is masked
preconditions: Given the Stride login screen is displayed
steps: When the user inspects the password input type
expected: Then the password input type is password

name: Logout terminates authenticated session
preconditions: Given the user is logged in as admin
steps: When the user clicks Log out
expected: Then login screen returns and sessionStorage auth flag is cleared

name: Direct access to protected UI without auth is prevented
preconditions: Given the user is not authenticated
steps: When the user opens the application home URL
expected: Then the login screen is shown and app shell is hidden

name: Catalogue displays configured unique shoe models
preconditions: Given the user is logged in
steps: When the user opens Collection All shoes
expected: Then about 40 unique shoe models are listed without duplicate ids

name: Shoe detail shows brand model size description pros cons suitability
preconditions: Given the user is logged in on Collection
steps: When the user opens details for a shoe
expected: Then modal shows brand, model, description, pros, cons, and suitability info

name: Brand or model search returns relevant results
preconditions: Given the user is on Collection
steps: When the user searches for Nike
expected: Then only Nike-related shoes remain visible

name: Missing product information handled gracefully
preconditions: Given the user is on Collection
steps: When shoes with empty images are rendered
expected: Then cards render without crashing and placeholders or empty galleries are shown

name: Select location and retrieve matching weather
preconditions: Given the user is logged in on Home
steps: When the user searches London and selects a result
expected: Then forecast shows a temperature and place related to London

name: Invalid location shows appropriate feedback
preconditions: Given the user is logged in on Home
steps: When the user searches for a nonsensical place name
expected: Then a no-match locations message is shown

name: Weather provider failure does not fabricate data
preconditions: Given weather API calls are aborted
steps: When the user selects a location
expected: Then failure feedback is shown and temperature is not a fabricated real reading

name: Commute Bike Cycle Car yields suitability-aligned recommendations
preconditions: Given location weather is loaded
steps: When the user selects Bike commute
expected: Then recommendation section appears with at least one matching pair or empty state message

name: Changing location weather or commute refreshes recommendations
preconditions: Given commute recommendations are shown
steps: When the user changes commute from Bike to Car
expected: Then selection summary updates to the new commute

name: Commute no-match shows empty state
preconditions: Given filters that yield no shoes if possible
steps: When recommendations are empty
expected: Then a meaningful no-match message is displayed when no pairs match

name: Running type and distance produce suitability-aligned recommendations
preconditions: Given the user is on Running view
steps: When location, distance 10km, and Daily Running are selected
expected: Then running shoe grid shows matching shoes

name: Invalid or unsupported running distance rejected
preconditions: Given the Running distance control min 1 max 42
steps: When the distance input bounds are inspected
expected: Then the control enforces 1-42 km range

name: Running parameter change refreshes results and no-match message
preconditions: Given running recommendations are visible
steps: When the user changes running type
expected: Then results refresh for the new type

name: Brand filter and colour variant images
preconditions: Given the user is on Collection Brands tab
steps: When the user opens Brands and selects a brand
expected: Then only that brand shoes are listed and brand count is shown

name: Missing or broken images use consistent placeholder
preconditions: Given collection cards with missing images
steps: When product images fail or are empty
expected: Then a consistent placeholder treatment is used without breaking the card

name: Combined filters update consistently without resetting unrelated params
preconditions: Given Home location and commute selected
steps: When the user navigates to Collection and back to Home
expected: Then previously selected location remains visible

name: Same shoe details consistent across Home Collection Running
preconditions: Given a known shoe appears in Collection
steps: When details are opened from Collection
expected: Then brand and name in modal match the card

name: Input sanitization SQLi and XSS rejected safely
preconditions: Given the login screen
steps: When XSS and SQLi payloads are submitted as credentials
expected: Then login fails safely with no script execution and app remains on login

name: Unauthorized API page access prevented and secrets not exposed
preconditions: Given unauthenticated browser context
steps: When /api/admin/catalog is requested without token
And page source is checked for Zephyr tokens
expected: Then admin API is unauthorized and frontend HTML does not embed API tokens

name: E2E happy path plus boundary empty search and navigation
preconditions: Given a fresh browser session
steps: When user logs in, selects location, commute, browses collection, running, empty search, and logs out
expected: Then each module works and logout returns to login without JS crash
